subject.title: fix(cron): default isolated agentTurn delivery to none, don't fail run on delivery error

question: Should OpenClaw retain current main’s shared announce-by-default policy for isolated/current/session output jobs, or adopt a narrowly conditional silent default only when no delivery was explicitly requested and no channel can resolve?
rationale: The submitted global default reversal changes established message-delivery behavior and conflicts with the newer centralized policy; choosing the compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Retain shared announce default
options.body: Keep the current main policy and close or replace this branch because its two local fallback edits regress explicit mode-less delivery.

options.title: Narrow no-channel degradation
options.body: Keep announce as the configured/default intent but make only an unresolved implicit last-channel delivery complete silently while explicit targets continue to fail clearly.

options.title: Adopt silent-by-default
options.body: Deliberately switch all omitted delivery modes to none only with an upgrade decision, documentation, and full cross-path regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Retain shared announce default
recommendation.body: Keep the current main policy and close or replace this branch because its two local fallback edits regress explicit mode-less delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged current-main work owns the centralized default-delivery invariant that this PR would reverse.
